senses.gloss: m. (עָדַן), pl. עִידּוּנִים, עִידּוּנִין delicacies, indulgenceindelicacies; הנהיג ע׳ בעצמו to indulge one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 20b">Taan. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>שכח … ולא ינהיג ע׳ וכ׳</he> if he forgot himself and ate and drank (on a day observed as a fast day in the place), he must not show himself before the public, nor must he indulge himself with delicacies; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 148:4">Yalk. Gen. 148</cite>.
